question: Where’s the closest museum lying along the route toward Westchester Women's Medical Healthcare, Mount Vernon, NY from Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hauppauge%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Westchester Women''s Medical Healthcare%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mount Vernon%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(o.geometry, d.geometry)::geography, 1000) AS buffered_route FROM origin o, destination d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, destination d, route_line_buffer rlb WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, rlb.buffered_route) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
